undeclared_policy.quote: A large portion of each entering class is undecided or exploring their academic major. Many students change majors at least once before graduating - college is a great time to learn about yourself and your interests! … As an undecided major, you'll have the opportunity to explore your options while working on ~40 credit hours of General Education requirements. The undergraduate catalog states students should declare a major before completing 42 credit hours. This helps ensure that you can graduate in a timely manner. Start the exploration process early!
